Description: Dual 1-Form-A/B solid-state relay, used as SPDT (350 V, 150 mA); 8/7 = NC to Micra, 6/5 = NO to remote
Notes: THT on purpose: Panasonic AQW612EH drops in if the NC/NO mapping proves wrong (then R2-R5 -> 270R). Meter 8-7 continuity unpowered before fab.

Description: 1-Form-A PhotoMOS relay (60 V, 550 mA, 3 mA max LED); drives Micra W/B from GPIO52
Notes: AQY212EHA is the SMD variant - board wants the DIP.

Description: JST PH 2.0 mm 5-pos side-entry header; Apollo (GND_R/5V/DRIVE/SENSE/CTRL)
Notes: Same drills as vertical B5B-PH-K if side-entry is out of stock.

Description: JST PH 2.0 mm 4-pos side-entry header; machine (P1/P2/W/B)
Notes: Same drills as vertical B4B-PH-K if side-entry is out of stock.

Description: USB 2.0 Type-C receptacle, through-hole; 5 V power in only (VBUS -> J1 5V, GND -> GND_R)
Notes: Power only: D+/D-/SBU unused. R9/R10 (5k1 Rd on CC1/CC2) make it a default-5 V sink so any USB-C source

Description: Thick film resistor 330 ohm 1% 0.25 W; R1 = U1 LED, R2-R5 = U2/U3 LEDs
Notes: Switch to 270R if AQW612EH is fitted.

Description: Thick film resistor 1 kohm 1% 0.25 W; SENSE series protection
Thick film resistor 10 kohm 1% 0.25 W; SENSE pull-up (with D1)
Thick film resistor 2.2 kohm 1% 0.25 W; LED1 current limit
Small-signal diode; pull-up steering for R7
Notes: PCB pads are D_1206; 1N4148W is SOD-123 and sits on them - check fit or pick a 1206-bodied diode.

Description: Green indicator LED, lit while CTRL is high
Thick film resistor 5.1 kohm 1% 0.25 W; USB-C CC1/CC2 Rd pull-downs to GND_R
Notes: One per CC pin - never share one resistor between CC1 and CC2.

Description: PTC resettable fuse, 1.5 A hold / 3.0 A trip, 12 V, 1812; in series with USB-C VBUS before J1 5V
Notes: Bourns MF-MSMF150-2 is EOL. Alternate: TE MINISMDC150F-2 (6 V, same pads). Hold current derates roughly 1%/degC above 25 C (about 0.9 A at 85 C) - still 1.5x the remote's 0.6 A peak.
